name: grace & stella Gel Under Eye Masks (6 Pairs)
seoTitle: Under Eye Gel Patches Gift for Tired Nurses
metaDescription: Cooling gel under eye patches from grace & stella, a small self care gift for nurses coming off night shift or a run of 12 hour days. Six pairs included.
summary: A pack of gel under eye patches is a little self care ritual for after a long shift, an easy way to tell a nurse to sit down and take ten minutes for herself.
whyItWorks: Twelve hour shifts, early alarms, and night rotations all show up on the face eventually, and most nurses know the feeling of looking in the break room mirror at hour eleven. Gel eye patches are a small, pampering way to recover after work. They ask for nothing more than lying back for a few minutes, which is exactly the point.

As a gift, they say you noticed how hard she works and want her to rest, without making a big deal of it. The six pairs give several sessions, so she can use them after a string of nights or before a day off. They fit nicely into a self care bundle with a candle, cozy socks, and a good hand cream for skin worn down by constant washing. They also make a thoughtful stocking stuffer for a nurse friend or a sweet pick me up for a nursing student surviving exam week.
goodToKnow: Keep the claims modest when giving them; think relaxing ritual, not a fix for exhaustion.
Check the listing for ingredients if the recipient has sensitive skin or allergies.
Popping them in the fridge before use is a common trick for an extra cooling feel.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a night shift nurse?
faq.a: Yes. Night shift nurses often come home wiped out, and a few quiet minutes with cooling patches makes a nice wind down routine.

faq.q: Is skincare a safe gift for a coworker?
faq.a: Eye patches are general enough to feel friendly rather than personal, so they work well for Secret Santa or a Nurses Week basket.
